description: Buy a local number for the user's account (it's theirs immediately and replies land in their SMS inbox). It can't send texts until their carrier registration is approved. Plans include some numbers; beyond that each costs $5/mo from the Spur wallet, first month charged now (spur_get_texting_setup shows the user's price). Tell the user the price and get explicit approval for this exact number first.

confirm.description: Set to true ONLY after the user explicitly approved this exact action in the conversation. Never assume approval.

locality.description: City from the search result, for display

region.description: State from the search result, for display
